title: Despite withdrawn proposals, Rams remain salty about Seattle's two-point conversion

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Despite withdrawn proposals, Rams remain salty about Seattle's two-point conversion
sources.description: Last night, upon learning that the Rams have withdrawn two different rule proposals arising from the Seahawks' crazy Week 16 two-point play, we asked the Rams if they had any comment on the development.
